purpose: Prospective raw collection; no economic hypothesis is tested or promoted here. Development probes are labelled separately.
discovery: Every emitted log from the six documented contracts; no return, liquidity, age, popularity or survival filter. Canonical Pancake V2/V3 factories identify pools. Classic Four V2 only; OpenFour and Infinity are not claimed covered.
tracking: All logs of every observed non-core token and canonical pool, from its first-observed block; creator and birth known only when the corresponding creation event was captured. No silent removal of inactive tokens.
raw: Original response bytes base64-encoded, request parameters, receipt time, HTTP status, explicit truncation; no captured session credentials.
time: Block timestamp and receipt timestamp remain separate. Historical catch-up is not treated as live information. No interpolation of missing external snapshots.
enrichment: DexScreener and GoPlus public batch reads; missing/restricted data stays unknown. Provider reports and transfer-event balances are not execution proofs.
persistence: Immutable daily GitHub release archives; verified download and all file digests before CAS checkpoint head; restart from saved cursor. Archives have no Actions artifact expiration.
sampling: Protocol scans every cycle; token/pool streams round robin; external snapshot targets 60s young, 300s mid-age and 1800s older when capacity permits. Actual delays and cursors are measured.
outcome_evaluation: No full-life, daily-profit, fraud, low-ruin or optimal-stake claims. Strategy registration, chronological split and single blind evaluation are separate future requirements.
